library_summary_es: La evidencia depende mucho de la preparación, dosis, población y objetivo; no debe extrapolarse entre extractos diferentes.
review_requirements: Verify indication-specific human evidence, comparator and effect sizes
Verify studied dose, formulation, duration and target population
Verify precautions, contraindications, interactions and adverse effects
Check cumulative exposure, special populations and missing safety answers
Independent scientific and clinical review required before any activation
